name: comp-424
title: Removable Badge
description: A white pill reading Removable next to a thin grey X; pressing the X removes the tag, leaving the stage empty.
use: Letting people clear applied filters, tags or recipients one at a time.
avoid: When removal must be reversible: the tag vanishes instantly with no undo or motion hint.
a11y: The X button carries no accessible name, so screen readers announce an unnamed button; there is no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A white capsule, roughly 300px wide on black, with dark grey sentence-case text and a slim grey X tucked at its right end. Ends are fully rounded and there is no border or shadow.
behaves: Hovering the X darkens it toward black; clicking it deletes the whole badge at once, and the stage goes blank with no fade or undo.
customise: The label word is hardcoded, so renaming it means editing the file; the pill look comes from the shared badge component and its class list.
weight: light: One small button with a colour transition; no library or animation loop.
issues: The close button has no aria-label, so assistive tech meets an unnamed button.
polishWhy: Crisp simple capsule with a tidy close affordance; otherwise a familiar default badge.
